item.title: Nigeria, U.S. forces kill over 20 Islamic State group militants in new offensive
item.description: The Nigerian military says a new operation with U.S. forces has killed over 20 Islamic State militants in Borno state

item.title: Iranian Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi released from hospital
item.description: Iranian Nobel Peace Prize laureate Narges Mohammadi has been released from the hospital after more than two weeks

item.title: Houthi-controlled court in Yemen sentences 19 to death for aiding Saudi-led coalition
item.description: A Houthi-controlled court in Yemen has sentenced 19 people to death for collaborating with the Saudi-led coalition fighting the Iranian-backed rebels
